title: Refs #36947 -- Added missing max_length in GeneratedField test for Oracle.
body:
This was missed because the model was defined inline without running system checks, where we would have seen:

```py
<Error: level=40, msg="GeneratedField.output_field has errors:\n    CharFields must define a 'max_length' attribute. (fields.E120)", hint=None, obj=<django.db.models.fields.generated.GeneratedField: name_lower>, id='fields.E223'>]
```

Follow-up to 64edef37e7b419dd584307d84650a192fb47dc4c.

Good timing: we just enabled daily test runs on Oracle 26ai on a [mirror](https://github.com/django-sandbox/django/actions/workflows/oracle.yml). 🎁
